arms.purpose: practical break-even baseline; no safe-pruning gate
same semantic gate/probes as treatment but executes all admissible full queries
same gate/probes; suppresses only R1-proven safe-prunable full queries

binding_rule: Binding depends only on frozen query_id/evidence_atoms/archetype and never on measured resource outcomes.

cache_policy.primary: warm/stable backend after fixed warm-up; randomized arm order within paired blocks
cache_policy.secondary: cold-start sensitivity via controlled container restart only after primary protocol is fixed

inadmissible_handling: SAT_FALSE is rejected identically in PERMISSIVE_GATED and SAFE_PRUNING and is reported separately from strategic pruning.

measurement.net_benefit_rule: All gate work, including any backend/NVAC probe, is counted as treatment overhead. A resource-saving claim requires treatment total cost < comparator total cost.
measurement.objective_rule: SAFE_PRUNING and PERMISSIVE_GATED must preserve identical frozen objective-completion semantics; R3 does not re-label semantic outcomes.

sampling.calibration_val: 2 lexicographically first sessions per stratum; expected 40 sessions; no effect-size tuning
sampling.confirmatory_test: all frozen test sessions; expected 300 sessions
sampling.pilot_dev: 1 lexicographically first session per (topology,pattern) stratum; expected 20 sessions; instrumentation only
sampling.quota_fallback: If external quota/runtime prevents full test execution, use first 6 test sessions per stratum (120 total), declare resource-constrained confirmatory subset, and do not select based on observed effects.
